Part 2 in Development 🔨

You are on a plane to visit your family back home, you spot a familiar figure but can’t recall from where. You pass out and wake up somewhere you don’t recognise...

Horror, Epilepsy & Jump-scare warning! ⚠

"The Hatman" is in its alpha release stage. If you encounter any bugs, please let us know in the community server. It is also a solo passion project—likes, favourites, and donations are highly appreciated!
